title: E1 — Water inlet failure (4 min fill)

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool 18" & 24" ADA Built-In Dishwasher Service Manual

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dishwasher or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: E1 behavior
steps.body: E1 displays when the flow meter cannot detect a correct fill after 4 minutes during the inlet step. Quick indicator flashes (SSD) or E1 on seven-segment display.
steps.sourceExcerpt: IF THE FLOW METER CAN'T DETECT A CORRECT FILL AFTER 4 MINUTES, E1 WILL BE DISPLAYED.

steps.title: Water supply and installation
steps.body: Verify supply valve on, 20–100 psi pressure, inlet screen clean, drain hose not siphoning, and dishwasher level.

steps.title: Fill circuit inspection
steps.body: Power off. Access kick panel and control board cover. Inspect CN5 inlet harness, CN4 flow meter, pressure switch hose to sump, and drain path. Run fill-valve ohms (w11187658-fill-valve) and drain pump test if needed.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Access kick panel and control board cover. Inspect CN5 inlet harness, CN4 flow meter, pressure switch hose to sump, and drain path. Run fill-valve ohms (w11187658-fill-valve) and drain pump test if needed.

steps.title: Pressure switch hose
steps.body: Pressure switch hose runs from switch on base bracket to sump. Hose kinked, disconnected, blocked, or leaking?

steps.title: Flow meter at CN4
steps.body: Inspect CN4 flow meter / thermistor / overflow harness for damage or poor connection at control board.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Inspect CN4 flow meter / thermistor / overflow harness for damage or poor connection at control board.

steps.title: Correct supply issue
steps.body: Restore water supply, correct installation, and retest fill.
steps.oemOutcome: Restore water supply, correct installation, and retest fill.

steps.title: Repair pressure switch path
steps.body: Repair or replace pressure switch hose; verify switch seated on base bracket.
steps.oemOutcome: Repair or replace pressure switch hose; verify switch seated on base bracket.

steps.title: Fill path verified
steps.body: Supply, inlet valve, flow meter, pressure switch, and drain prerequisites checked — retest for E1.
steps.oemOutcome: Supply, inlet valve, flow meter, pressure switch, and drain prerequisites checked — retest for E1.
